title: Nebraska AI Laws

reading.body:
Nebraska has passed one AI-related law, and it regulates conversational AI through disclosure and safety duties rather than through compute or data centers.

LB525, passed 2026-04-17, does two separate things. It adopts the Agricultural Data Privacy Act, which gives producers ownership of data from their farm, land, devices, and equipment, bars sale of that data without express written consent, and requires reasonable security. It also adopts the Conversational Artificial Intelligence Safety Act, which places disclosure, content prevention, privacy tool, and crisis protocol duties on operators of conversational AI services, with particular attention to minor account holders. The same law amends the public records law so agricultural data can be withheld without the owner's prior written consent.

For AI specifically, the binding constraint named here is not power or buildings. It is the operator's obligations at the point of conversation: what must be disclosed, what content must be prevented, what privacy tools must exist, and what happens in a crisis. That is a consumer protection model, and it reaches the model through the service interface rather than through the facility that trains or serves it.

The data covers one law and nothing else. It does not say how the duties are enforced, what penalties attach, which agency administers them, or whether the agricultural data provisions have any AI component at all. It also does not establish that Nebraska's approach resembles any other state's, because no other state's laws are in this data.

Nebraska has enacted 1 AI-related law. Each is read from its enrolled text: what it does, who it applies to, when it takes effect, and what it requires.

Enacted AI laws in Nebraska

1 law this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • LB525: Adopt the Agricultural Data Privacy Act and the Conversational Artificial Intelligence Safety Act passed 2026-04-17

    The law adopts the Agricultural Data Privacy Act, which gives agricultural producers ownership and control of agricultural data originating from their farm, land, devices, and equipment, and prohibits controllers and processors from selling that data without express written consent while requiring reasonable data security. It also adopts the Conversational Artificial Intelligence Safety Act, which imposes disclosure, content prevention, privacy tool, and crisis protocol duties on operators of conversational artificial intelligence services, especially for minor account holders. It amends the public records law to allow withholding agricultural data absent prior written consent from the owner.

How this page is kept

This page is generated from the enacted laws this site tracks for Nebraska. When the legislature passes another AI-related bill, it appears here the night the bill's text is read. The full 50-state picture is at State AI Laws.
